Agent Name: InformationExtraction_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to correctly identify the specific URL for the "1.E Exercises" section of the LibreTexts Introductory Chemistry materials. Instead of using the correct path (which includes "Introduction_to_General_Organic_and_Biochemistry"), the agent used a URL pointing to a completely different book ("An_Introduction_to_the_Electronic_Structure_of_Atoms_and_Molecules_(Bader)"). This fundamental error in URL construction at the very first step of data retrieval led to all subsequent attempts to find the equine veterinarian in that specific document failing, as the agent was searching the wrong source entirely.
